invariants.contract: With a working SMTP transport, POST /emails/test sends one message from fromAddress to testAddress (or fromAddress fallback), with subject 'Test email from Audiobookshelf' and text 'Success!', then returns the Express sendStatus(200) response.
When SMTP transport verification fails, POST /emails/test returns status 400 with the fixed verification error as an Express text/html send response and does not send an email.

evidence: go-backend/contracts/parity/email-test-differential-report.json: fresh pinned v2.37.2 fixture run; 144/144 route cases passed, including six SMTP test setup/delivery/failure observations.

exceptions: Delivery evidence is limited to one plaintext unauthenticated local SMTP server and one rejected SMTP greeting. Repeat sends, changed recipient settings, TLS/auth, sendMail-stage rejection, attachment delivery, admin denial, and other edge variants remain unverified.
The verification-failure path is not forced by a handler flag; the independent local SMTP fixture returns 421 before mail data can be sent.
